name: How long does a room expansion project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a room expansion project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a room expansion varies depending on the size and complexity of the project. A small, straightforward addition might take 3-6 months from design to completion. Larger or more intricate expansions, especially those requiring extensive structural work or specialized finishes, can take 6-12 months or even longer. Permitting can also add several weeks or months to the overall timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule once the scope is defined.
acceptedAnswer.description: A room expansion can take 3-12 months or more, depending on its size, complexity, and permitting requirements.
